info.name: Coveo Activity Activities Organization Access API
List Groups with Privilege Access Level

params.name: organizationId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
**Example:** `mycoveocloudv2organizationg8tp8wu3`

params.name: privilegeOwner
params.description: The `owner` value the groups privileges must match to be included in the response.

params.name: privilegeTargetDomain
params.description: The `targetDomain` value the groups privileges must match to be included in the response.

params.name: accessLevel
params.description: The [access level](https://docs.coveo.com/en/2818/) the groups privileges must match to be included in the response.</br>**Allowed values:**</br>- `EDIT_ALL`: Groups can edit the organization.</br>- `CUSTOM`: Groups have custom access to the organization.</br>- `VIEW_ALL`: Groups can view the organization.</br>- `NONE`: Groups have no access to the organization.

items.docs:
Lists groups with a specific privilege [access level](https://docs.coveo.com/en/2818/) in an [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
See [Privilege reference](https://docs.coveo.com/en/1707/).

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"PLATFORM","targetDomain":"GROUP","type":"VIEW","targetId":"*"} OR {"owner":"{privilegeOwner}","targetDomain":"{privilegeTargetDomain}","type":"VIEW","targetId":"*"} ```

info.name: List API Keys with Privilege Access Level

params.name: organizationId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
**Example:** `mycoveocloudv2organizationg8tp8wu3`

params.name: privilegeOwner
params.description: The `owner` value an API key must have to be included in the response.

params.name: privilegeTargetDomain
params.description: The `targetDomain` value an API key must have to be included in response.

params.name: accessLevel
params.description: The [access level](https://docs.coveo.com/en/2818/) an API key must have to be included in the response.</br>**Allowed values:**</br>- `EDIT_ALL`: API key can edit the organization.</br>- `CUSTOM`: API key has custom access to the organization.</br>- `VIEW_ALL`: API key can view the organization.</br>- `NONE`: API key has no access to the organization.

items.docs:
Lists the API keys with a specific privilege [access level](https://docs.coveo.com/en/2818/) in an [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).

See [Privilege reference](https://docs.coveo.com/en/1707/).

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"PLATFORM","targetDomain":"API_KEY","type":"VIEW","targetId":"*"} ```
